text: Easy to put together but the drawers are extremely flimsy .... VERY SMALL. Easy to put together but the drawers are extremely flimsy since they don't sit on any kind of a track & they don't have a real stopper. Just 1 "wooden" peg. Came with all pieces & looks nice once completed though.

product_metadata.title: Winsome Ava model name Accent Table, Black
features: A simple yet functional table can be used as accent or night stand. Perfect for your night time essentials with two drawers plus open cabinet for storage. It is suitable for any room and décor. Ample storage and comes ready to assemble.
Overall table size 15.75"W x 12.6"D x 23.7"H. Top dimension is 15.75"W x 11.8"D.
Inside drawer is 12.75"W x 9.6"D x 3.75"H. Open cabinet is 14.25"W x 11"D x 9.3"H.
Made in black veneer on composite wood. Assembly required.
